item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra baH dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las srung ba rin chen gur khang
item.coloph: dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud la/ bsrungs (srung) ba rin chen gur khang zhes bya ba / dbal gshen stag la me 'bar thugs bcud gsang ba'o/ 'di 'dra'i bsrungs ((srung) ba khyad par can/ rin chen gling gi snying po gser/ (stang) bon gyi nang nas man ngag bcud/ lha klu mi gsum snang mdog bka'/ gyer spung bdag gis (gi) thugs kyi bcud/ sdang chen thugs gis (kyis) dkyil du zhog phyi rabs gshen la smon lam thob/ ces gsungs nas gtad do//
